title: Reduce contract WebView flat export
summary: Removed the Contract page `initContractViewEvents` flat WebView alias while preserving namespace access through `window.mediaPipelineContractView`.
reason: The active WebView cleanup workstream calls for reducing transitional flat `window.*` exports opportunistically by touched domain. The Contract page already exported its initializer through the namespace object, so app startup can use namespace-first access without keeping the flat alias.
behavior_before: Contract event initialization was available through both `window.mediaPipelineContractView.initContractViewEvents` and the flat `window.initContractViewEvents` compatibility alias, and app startup called the flat global.
behavior_after: Contract event initialization remains available through `window.mediaPipelineContractView.initContractViewEvents`; app startup calls that namespace member and the flat `window.initContractViewEvents` alias is removed from the WebView public contract and global export inventory.
